text:
morgan: Heads-up — customer hit a surge of 413s on the embeddings endpoint after the console soft-quota rollout. They were sending a mixed-dim batch and the request got routed to shard-B which enforces a 2MB per-payload cap.

sujeet: Which tenant / any reproducible payload? Is this bytes-limit or shard-level QPS killing it?

morgan: Tenant redacted-123. Repro in staging: 120 vectors total, ~80x512-dim and 40x1536-dim mixed in one array. Total body ~4.2MB. Routing chosen shard-B -> 413.

eli: We route by primary dim-profile header right now. The splitter only auto-splits uniform-dim batches unless `byte-split` opt-in is used. Mixed dims fall through.

roxanne: @sujeet @eli console showed an "estimated split" suggestion only for uniform dims. Users saw the UI hint but the API still rejected the request when routed. Confusing UX. :eyes:

morgan: Quick log snippet from staging: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers:
  Content-Type: application/json
  X-Embed-Dims: 1536,512,512,1536,...
Body: [ [..vectors..] ] (4.2MB)
Response: 413 Payload Too Large
Routing decision: shard-B (max_payload_bytes=2097152)
Splitter: no-op (mixed dims, byte-splitting disabled)
```

sujeet: Concrete proposal: (1) Emit a preflight telemetry event when a request is likely to cross per-shard byte limits, (2) surface a split suggestion header from preflight, (3) make console show actionable split/curl helper even for mixed dims.

eli: Also add server-side opt-in header `Prefer: prefer_auto_split=true` that will make the ingress auto-retry with dim-aware splits. We should set a conservative backoff and keep idempotency semantics. Latency cost for preflight is ~1-3ms.

roxanne: UX note: Console copy should avoid scaring customers about cost. Frame it as "This request may fail on some nodes — try splitting into N requests for higher success rate. Estimated cost: Packed = $0.042, Split (2x) = $0.045". Show both unit estimates.

api-deploy-bot: Canary rollout: preflight-split-suggestion enabled for 20% traffic on eng-platform at 2026-03-20T15:12Z.

morgan: Proposed API change: preflight response header `X-Split-Suggestion: suggested=[{parts:2, strategy:\"dim-aware\"}]`. Clients can call `/v1/embeddings?split=2&strategy=dim-aware` or set `Prefer: prefer_auto_split=true` to auto-retry. Fallback behavior: if auto-split fails, surface original 413.

sujeet: Implementation caveats: preflight increases ingress CPU and adds ~2ms p95 latency. Need to ensure we don't leak vector contents into routing telemetry. Events should be counts + dims metadata, not raw vectors.

eli: Telemetry plan: emit `preflight.split_suggestion` with fields (tenant, suggested_parts, total_bytes, max_shard_bytes), `route.reject.413`, and `console.split_click`. Dashboards: per-tenant 413 rate, preflight suggest rate, split-adoption %, cost delta between packed vs split. Set alert when 413 rate > 0.5% of embedding traffic for a tenant.

roxanne: I'll mock console flows: "Suggest split" CTA, copyable curl for split, and cost comparison table. Also add a small inline explanation of why mixed dims matter (routing + packing).

morgan: Ok next steps: @sujeet prototype preflight + header, @eli wire telemetry events + alerts, @roxanne produce console mockups and copy. I'll coordinate canary and customer comms. Target: canary next week.

roxanne: I'll prepare a short doc for support with reproduction steps and suggested troubleshooting commands.

morgan: ack :thumbsup: Thanks all.
